Going to Hakone between 7 and 24 December 2026? Part of the ropeway will be a bus that week. Here's the one thing to check before you plan your loop day 👇

👀 One of these surprised even us. Find out which 👉 https://japanbystation.com/hakone-freepass-ryokan-one-night

⚠️ THE MISTAKE

Planning the classic Hakone loop on a fixed timetable without checking maintenance dates. The ropeway closes sections for regular work, and the replacement buses can be crowded.

✅ THE DATES (Odakyu Hakone notice)

🚌 7 to 24 December 2026: Owakudani to Sounzan runs as a replacement bus, about 10 minutes one way.

🚌 12 January to 26 February 2027: Togendai to Ubako to Owakudani runs as a bus, about 15 minutes one way.

🎫 Buses leave about every 15 minutes, and Hakone Freepass holders can use them.

💡 THE FIX

Give that day an extra half hour. Odakyu itself suggests reaching Owakudani on the section that is still running.

If the weather stops a service, unused parts of the Freepass are refunded at your last station, so keep the pass until the end.

👉 One Gora Park ticket, two visits, and the fare maths for a ryokan night:
https://japanbystation.com/hakone-freepass-ryokan-one-night

Save this if Hakone is on your winter list.
